annotations.title: Diaspora metro snapshot — directory counts by metro and category

description: Diaspora metro snapshot — directory counts by metro and category. Counts of African and Caribbean diaspora business listings in the Ni Biashara directory (nibiashara.com) by metro and by category, with contact-field coverage, computed from the live directory at call time. Filter by metro and/or category, or omit both for the whole directory. Counts only, no business-level fields. Counts reflect the directory, not a census. $0.02 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

metro.description: metro to filter, e.g. DFW, Houston, Toronto (optional)
